state.behavior: Each owner selects one operation before hydration. State stores only the selected operation, selected fence, selected abort, and fixed participant stages. Mutation methods require exact selected operation; calls must source-verify participants. The stream is fully loaded by Portia and generic read freshness is unqualified.
state.scenarios: An original draft operation A is pending. A distinct cancellation operation B commits an event naming A. Replaying with selected A marks A refused; replaying with selected B records B accepted. Current lifecycle is scalar and remains correct under either selection.

full_load_avoided.instructions: Does the selected-operation approach by itself avoid Portia loading the full edition event stream?

unselected_write.instructions: Given state.behavior, can an unselected owner safely accept a mutation with an operation whose history it did not select?

selected_retention.instructions: Given state.code, does retained operation-specific state grow with the number of distinct historical operation IDs?

cancel_target_receipt.instructions: Given state.scenarios, can the selected original operation retain its refused receipt while a different operation performs cancellation?

cancel_own_receipt.instructions: Given state.scenarios, can the selected cancellation operation retain its own accepted receipt without storing the original operation history?

changed_retry.instructions: Given state.behavior, should reusing the selected operation ID with changed authored intent be accepted as an exact retry?

different_generation.instructions: Given state.behavior, should a callback reusing an event ID but changing its label generation be accepted as an exact retry?

different_reason.instructions: Given state.behavior, should a refusal callback reusing an event ID but changing its refusal reason be accepted as an exact retry?

other_history_unique.instructions: Does replay of an unrelated unselected operation by itself prove that every operation ID in the entire historical stream was unique?

source_authority.instructions: Does choosing an operation ID and replaying through an ordinary event reader prove that the source was fresh after an ambiguous commit?

all_children.instructions: Does deciding a single edition lifecycle transition require this owner to retain all criteria entries?

safe_noop.instructions: Can a no-op return a durable exact retry outcome without persisting any intent or receipt anywhere?
